# tenferro v0.8.0

v0.8.0 puts every CPU computation behind caller-held engines and one placement
token. You build a `Pool`, hand it to `CpuEngine::new`, and each operation mints
one `strided_exec::Exec` token from it; strided kernels, the provider libraries
and tenferro's own fan-out split that token, so the tasks running at once under
one operation never exceed its budget and no code path reaches a process-global
thread pool. The CPU stack moves to strided-rs 0.7, tcontract 0.5, cpueinsum 0.5
and tlinalg 0.5.

## Migration

- Update every `tenferro-*` requirement from `0.7` to `0.8` together. All CPU
  stack crates must be on strided 0.7 / tcontract 0.5 / cpueinsum 0.5 /
  tlinalg 0.5 (a mixed graph gives two `StridedView` or two `Exec` types).
- Sessions are gone; use caller-held engines. The full table of removed
  spellings (sessions, held sessions, phase leases, `run_compiled`, backend-owning
  eager runtimes) is in the
  [API migration guide](https://tensor4all.org/tenferro-rs/getting-started/api-migration.html).
- CPU placement:

  | v0.7 | v0.8 |
  | --- | --- |
  | `tenferro_cpu::thread_pool_builder().num_threads(n).build()?` | `tenferro_cpu::Pool::builder().threads(n).build()?` (a `strided_exec::Pool`; 16 MiB worker stack by default) |
  | `DEFAULT_WORKER_STACK_BYTES`, `MIN_WORKER_STACK_BYTES` | removed; `PoolBuilder::stack_size` |
  | `CpuEngine::new(rayon::ThreadPool)` | `CpuEngine::new(Pool)` |
  | `CpuEngine::pool()` | removed; `engine.exec()?.into_token()` |
  | direct faer on the engine's pool: `pool.install(\|\| .. Par::rayon(w))` | `engine.exec()?.into_token().external(\|w\| ..)`, `Par::Seq` for `w == 1`, else `Par::rayon(w.get())` |
  | `engine.pool_stats()`, `CpuPoolStats` | removed; tests use the `ledger` feature |
  | `CpuEngineError::CallerInOwnPool` | removed; a call from a worker of the engine's own pool runs in place |
  | `with_linalg_pool(\|ctx, buffers\| ..)` with `ctx: &CpuExecutionContext` | `\|exec, buffers\|` with `exec: &mut tcontract_exec::Exec`; `thread_budget()` is `exec.budget()` |
  | `CpuExecutionContext`, `ParallelMode`, `with_faer_width`, `contraction_exec`, `FanOut` | removed |
  | `scalar_binary_into(..)`, `scalar_fold(..)` | take the token as last argument, for example `tenferro_cpu::strided_exec::Exec::serial()` |
  | `RAYON_NUM_THREADS` sizing an engine pool | no effect; pass the width to `Pool::builder().threads(n)` |

  The token is named `tenferro_cpu::strided_exec::Exec`; `tenferro-cpu`
  re-exports `Pool`, `PoolBuilder` and the `strided_exec` crate, but not `Exec` at
  the root, because `CpuEngine::exec` returns the different `tcontract_exec::Exec`
  bundle (token, workspace, batch policy).
- No `tenferro` crate depends on `rayon` directly any more; `tenferro-fft` forks
  its lanes over the token.

## Features

- `[usize; N]` indexing and host views for any scalar.
  ([#2271](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2271))
- `tenferro_cpu::strided_exec` and `Pool`/`PoolBuilder` are available from
  `tenferro-cpu`, so engine users need no separate dependency.
  ([#2276](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2276))

## Performance

- Fused CPU softmax and activations run on the engine's pool, vectorized, with
  pooled outputs; `softmax` lives in `strided-nn`.
  ([#2231](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2231),
  [#2235](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2235),
  [#2276](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2276))
- Real FFTs use `realfft` for `rfft`/`irfft`.
  ([#2232](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2232))
- Runtime metadata views are folded into their consumer, trimming the fixed cost
  of a run. ([#2238](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2238))

## Fixes

- CPU fan-out of softmax and fused activations ignored the engine's pool and
  could start Rayon's global pool; a serial engine never starts or enters a pool
  now. ([#2273](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/issues/2273),
  [#2276](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2276))
- FFT correctness fixes.
  ([#2248](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2248))
- Patched SVD providers and t4a-faer 0.24.9 (divide-and-conquer SVD secular-root
  fix). ([#2236](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2236),
  [#2264](https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/pull/2264))

## Known limitations

- `tenferro-cpu`'s `integration::static_replay::static_analytic_replay_preserves_owned_and_reversed_values`
  differs in the last bit of `sin` on macOS.
- Work inside vendor BLAS/LAPACK and faer is bounded by the width the token hands
  over, not by tenferro; how faer divides that width is faer's concern.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tensor4all/tenferro-rs/compare/v0.7.1...v0.8.0
